toc_flags: ch02s06: bookmark hanzi is 待遇 (treatment/remuneration/pay); the translated TOC rendered it 'Rewards and Punishments' (=賞罰). Verify against scan; title_en set to literal 'Remuneration / Treatment' pending check.
ch05s04: 一般的祕密 ('General Secrets') is in the bookmarks but omitted from the translated TOC; title_en provisional.

Per the translated TOC's own notes, clean-read these OCR-carried entries: ch1 s3 items 2-4; ch3 s1 principles 2 and 5; the ch4 s2 title; several ch6 sub-items (two intro items under Weapons, Observation item 5, Hypnotism items 5 and 7).
toc_flags_resolved: ch02s06 = 待遇 'Treatment and Remuneration' (p62/printed 30). The translated TOC's 'Rewards and Punishments' (賞罰) was wrong.
ch05s04 = 一般的祕密 'Ordinary Secrets' (secrecy in everyday life; first sub-item 日常生活), p110/printed 78. It exists; the translated TOC omitted it.
ch04s02 = 觀念鬥爭 literally 'The Struggle over Mindset' (p72/85). The translated TOC's 'Building the Right Mindset' is an interpretation.

ch01s03 Scope enumeration (body p38-41) is, in order: 1 偵察 reconnaissance, 2 反偵探 counter-surveillance, 3 情報 intelligence, 4 交通 communications, 5 破壞 sabotage, 6 保護 protection. The translated TOC mislabeled items 2-4 and invented a 'Sanction/liquidation' that is not in the list.

ch03s01 Principles enumeration (body p72-75) is, in order: 1 積極性 proactiveness, 2 祕密性 secrecy, 3 敏捷性 agility, 4 精密性 precision, 5 普遍性 universality/comprehensiveness, 6 實際性 practicality. The translated TOC's item 2 'Flexibility' should be 'Secrecy', and its item 5 'Secrecy' should be 'Universality'; there is no 'flexibility' principle.
toc_flags_open: ch06 §4 (Weapons) intro items RESOLVED against the body (B07, folios 107-109): item 1 = 一、特務人員為什麼要懂得武器 (folio 107); item 2 = 二、那些武器比較適用於特務工作？ (folio 109), which then lists (一)手鎗 (二)毒氣鎗 (三)炸彈. Both confirmed present; bookmarks and body agree. STILL OPEN (B08): Observation item 5, and Hypnotism item 7 (催眠與暗示); confirmed earlier: Observation item 1 = 觀察技能在特務工作上的作用, Hypnotism item 5 = 被術者的體質 (the four temperaments).

citation_convention: Cite the book's OWN PRINTED FOLIO (the Chinese numeral at the page foot), never the PDF page number, which is a scan artifact. The PDF-to-printed offset DRIFTS (unpaginated plates are bound in through the book), so a folio must be READ OFF the scanned page, not computed from the PDF number. book.json's printed_page anchors are the section openers (from the TOC bookmarks); spot-verified so far: ch1 s1 = printed 1, ch2 s6 = printed 30, ch5 s4 = printed 78. Main text: printed pp 1-236 (confirmed by the errata table, whose last entry corrects printed p236). When a note cites a page, use the printed folio.

back_matter.note: Publisher's errata table: columns 頁數/行數/字數/誤字/漏字/校正及補入 (page/line/char-position/wrong-char/dropped-char/correction). RESEARCH-RELEVANT: apply these corrections to the source before translating the affected pages, and record them. Last entry references printed p236 (fixes the end of the main text). One entry (printed 206) appends a figure: 蘇聯格伯烏與軍隊的關係圖 (a chart of the Soviet GPU's relationship to the military) — relevant to ch7 s3.
不准翻印 (no reprinting). Printed 中華民國二十二年八月 (August 1933).
